privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This app organizes the events of a private group. This page explains which personal data it processes, why, who it is shared with and which rights you have under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacy.contactFallback: the administrator who created your account
privacy.controller.title: Data controller
privacy.controller.body: The data controller is {contact}. Contact them with any question or request about your data.
privacy.data.title: Data we process
privacy.data.body:
Account: name, email address and password, which Supabase Auth stores only in hashed form.
Groups and role: the groups you belong to and whether you are an administrator.
Content you add: events, responses and guests, proposals, votes, polls, things to bring and invitations.
Calendar: a secret personal code, if you turn on calendar sync.
Technical data: IP address and access logs kept by the providers for security and operation.
privacy.purposes.title: Purposes and legal basis
privacy.purposes.body: The data is used only to run the app: signing in, organizing events, replying and coordinating with the other members. The legal basis is providing the service you use as a group member (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and the legitimate interest in organizing the group's activities and protecting the app from abuse (Art. 6(1)(f)). There is no advertising, profiling or automated decision-making.
privacy.access.title: Who sees your data
privacy.access.body: Members of your groups see your name and your participation in the events they can access; invite-only events are visible only to the invitees. Administrators see every user's name, email and groups in order to manage accounts. Your data is never sold or passed on.
privacy.providers.title: Providers and transfers
privacy.providers.body:
The app is hosted by GitHub Pages (GitHub Inc.) and the data is stored by Supabase (Supabase Inc.) in the region chosen for the project. Both process data on behalf of the controller; any transfer to the United States is covered by the Standard Contractual Clauses or the Data Privacy Framework.
If you choose to open a place in Google Maps, share an event on WhatsApp, Telegram or by email, or subscribe to the calendar from Google, Apple or Outlook, the data needed goes to that service under its own privacy policy.
privacy.retention.title: Retention
privacy.retention.body: Data is kept as long as your account exists. When an administrator deletes your account, your profile, group memberships, responses, votes and calendar code are erased; events and other content you created stay without your name. Backups are encrypted and kept for at most 30 days.
privacy.storage.title: Cookies and local storage
privacy.storage.body: The app uses no analytics or tracking cookies. Your browser only keeps your sign-in session and your preferences (language and group filter): they are strictly necessary and need no consent.
privacy.rights.title: Your rights
privacy.rights.body: You can ask the controller at any time to access, correct, erase, restrict or port your data, or object to its processing. You can change your name and password yourself on your account page. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority, such as your national data protection authority.
privacy.changes.title: Changes
privacy.changes.body: If this notice changes, the new version is published on this page with its update date.
